gujarat.definition:
n. a region of western India to the north of Bombay (bordering the Arabian Sea) where Gujarati is spoken
n. an industrialized state in western India that includes parts of Bombay
gujarat.translation: n. 古吉拉特邦（印度西部的邦）

gujarati.definition:
n. a member of the people of Gujarat
n. the Indic language spoken by the people of India who live in Gujarat in western India
gujarati.translation: n. 古吉拉特人；古吉拉特语

gujarats.definition:
plural of Gujarat
n. a region of western India to the north of Bombay (bordering the Arabian Sea) where Gujarati is spoken
n. an industrialized state in western India that includes parts of Bombay
gujarats.translation: (Gujarat 的复数) n. 古吉拉特邦（印度西部的邦）
